environmental.operating-temp: to 70 C - 325 A per panel at 45 C, de-rated to 200 A at 70 C; no lower limit is stated

features.ethernet: one Ethernet connection, 10/100/1000 with PoE, in the datasheet (gap ethernet-ports)
features.load-shedding: per-circuit solid-state switching under software control: scheduled on/off, power cycle after failed pings, manual override; a DIP switch per circuit forces it on
features.monitoring: feed and per-circuit voltage and current; one analog (nrgTEMP) and one digital I2C (nrgILSTEMP) temperature probe

management.alarm-contacts: Form C relay per side, 2 A at 30 VDC and 0.6 A at 60 VDC, on wire-wrap terminals
management.interfaces: HTTPS web interface, REST API, SNMP v1, v2c and v3, SNTP, syslog; IPv4 and IPv6

physical.mounting: 19 inch brackets included; 23 inch brackets sold separately

power.input-dc: dual feed; maximum input load 325 A at 45 C per panel, de-rated to 200 A at 70 C; input wire 2/0 AWG to 350 MCM
power.output-breaker-max: 60 A single-pole; the UL rating holds to 48 A continuous per output

configs.description: The panel as it ships: no breakers, and a blanking cover over every position. Breakers are sold separately.
configs.name: base

configs.description: All sixteen positions fitted with breakers behind their touch guards, as every product photograph shows the panel, with an invented spread of ratings. An illustration, not an orderable bundle.
configs.name: populated

gaps.note: each feed is two stud terminals, one BATT and one RTN, and no drawing or sentence held says which is the outer one: the input-lug figure of the guide (Fig. 2-7) carries no legend, and its rear photograph prints BATT and RTN beside the output rows only. Each side is one part, `input-a` and `input-b`, whose two terminals are `terminal-1` and `terminal-2` by position, not by polarity.
gaps.wanted: a rear photograph that resolves the input legends, or the panel itself.

gaps.note: the nrgSMART controller datasheet prints its display as 2-line, Xx characters, with the count left blank, and the nrgILS datasheet calls this one an LCD and gives no count. Forty is the estimate amphenol-ns/nrg-oled@1 carries, from one photograph of the nrgSMART display.
gaps.wanted: the display part or its character count.

gaps.note: the face letters a RESET button and no document says what a press does; searched the guides and release notes for reset, press and factory.

Fig. 3-12 dimensions the nrgILS bottom view 387.9 (15.27 inch) overall, 42.4 more than the 300CB08 view above it; the specification tables of the same guide give the nrgILS300CB08 13.6 inch (346), the 300CB08's row repeated. The model carries the drawing, 373.2 of chassis.

gaps.note: the nrgILS datasheet gives -48 VDC alone; the face it photographs prints +/-12/24/48 V, the nrgSMART legend. The model carries the datasheet and draws the face as printed.

gaps.note: the datasheet lists one Ethernet connection, 10/100/1000 with PoE; the face has MGMT and LAN jacks in Fig. 3-2 and both datasheet photographs. The nrgils controller configuration/user guide 155376 configures one LAN and says nothing of MGMT.

neither the nrgILS datasheet, the installation guide nor the configuration guide states what the controller and its circuit switches draw; searched for watt, mA and consumption.

breaker-ratings.note: ONE MODULE CARRIES ELEVEN RATINGS AS A FIELD. The datasheet sells breakers from 2 A to 60 A as eleven part numbers that differ in nothing but the figure printed on the handle, so they are one part with a `rating` field, set per position in a configuration. Each breaker ships with a touch guard seated on it, a separate part that a configuration can take off. The populated example is an invented load to show the field working; the vendor publishes no standard fill.

chassis.note: 431.8 wide and 43.9 high as the 300CB08. THE DEPTH IS 373.2, read off the nrgILS bottom view, Fig. 3-12 (lower), which dimensions the panel 387.9 (15.27 inch) overall: the drawing is 1.19 px/mm on both axes (514 px across the 431.8 body, 461 px down the 387.9), and less the 14.7 the front guards stand proud, as on the 300CB08's own drawing above it, the chassis is 373.2. The extra 42.4 is all in the bottom pan; the rear terminal band measures the same on both drawings. THE SPECIFICATION TABLES DISAGREE: the installation guide gives the nrgILS300CB08 13.6 inch (346), the same row as the 300CB08 (gap depth).

display.note: the datasheet calls it an LCD; its close-up shows the same two-line black and white display, white text on black, as the nrgSMART controller, so amphenol-ns/nrg-oled@1 is reused. The datasheet sells a replacement LCD/carrier board with SOM, 090-1000-0011. The RESET button under it is named on the face and described nowhere.

ears.note: NOT DRAWN. The nrgILS datasheet gives 19 inch mounting brackets as included with the panel and 23 inch brackets as sold separately (its dimension rows); both bolt to the sides. Fig. 3-1 dimensions them at 482.6 and 584.2 over the body.

envelope-faces.note: Top, bottom, left and right are sized from the chassis. THE BOTTOM IS RE-READ off the nrgILS bottom view, Fig. 3-12 (lower), at 1.19 px/mm, origin the rear edge as on the 300CB08: the same four side fields, the rear pair 143.8 deep and the front pair 86.7, and a centre column the 300CB08 lacks, 32.8 wide, in two runs either side of a screw. The two ground bolts sit at the head of that column, 216.2 from the left on their centres, drawn on the stated 5/8 inch centres. The top keeps the 300CB08's two estimated side fields, lengthened by the extra depth. The sides take the 300CB08's readings off its side view, Fig. 3-4, which the guide does not repeat for the nrgILS: the four bracket holes are placed from the front and the two-bolt ground landing from the rear, where the nrgILS bottom view shows the side lug within 5 of its 300CB08 position.

front.note: The breaker cells and thumbscrews are the 300CB08. THE CENTRE PANEL IS THE CONTROLLER ONE, measured on Fig. 3-2, the embedded 1188 x 258 image on page 38, at the same 1.9685 px/mm: two RJ45 openings 14.7 wide either side of a display window 24.9 by 7.6, a small round button under the window, the two switch slots where the plain panel has them but 1.0 higher, five lamp holes 1.3 higher, and the card slot. What is printed comes from Fig. 2-14, which letters MGMT, an address above it, LAN, RESET, 1 and 8 at each slot, nrg over the centre lamp and the voltage at the lower left. That figure shows no maker name and no model on this face, and none is printed here. Legend positions are read off that figure by eye. THE ADDRESS ABOVE MGMT IS NOT DRAWN: the face prints the controller's factory default management address, a private (RFC 1918) address, centred over the jack about 3.9 from the top edge, and the repository's private-address gate keeps such addresses out of tracked files. Its place is left blank.

front-cover.note: THE FRONT FACE IS A REMOVABLE COVER. The guide has a procedure for it (section 2.2.7): two thumbscrews release a bar that spans the front, with sixteen openings the breaker guards show through and the lamps, switch slots and card slot in its centre. It is drawn as the panel, not as a part, because the panel is never seen without it in service and the breakers, not the cover, are what a position holds. The slot under the lamps is the designation card holder the datasheet lists.

ground-stud-size.note: the installation guide's specifications give the earth ground terminals as three sets of 1/4-20 threaded holes on 5/8 inch centres, bolted with washers to 50 in-lb, for a dual-hole compression lug on #6 to #1 AWG wire; its description says they take either a dual-hole or a single-hole lug and that only one ground connection is required: the `stud-size` of all six ground placements, two on each side and two on the bottom.

lamps.note: Five lamps: A PWR, A ALM, nrg, B ALM, B PWR. PWR is green with its feed present and ALM red on an alarm, as on the plain panel. The nrg lamp is the controller: the controller guide says the Identify button blinks it; the installation guide gives off, red, green and flashing red for the older nrg300CB08 in terms of nrgNET power, which these panels do not take. Red, green and a blink are recorded and no more. The nrgILS datasheet close-up shows the PWR lamps white-blue rather than green and the designation card slot glowing; a lit photograph at that size cannot separate lamp colour from white balance and reflection, so nothing is changed for it.

lifecycle.note: searched 2026-10-07 for an end-of-life, end-of-sale or discontinuation notice for the nrgILS300CB08 and found none; the vendor product page listed it as current at intake, 2026-10-05.

method.note: THE nrgILS IS THE CTRL FRONT ON A DEEPER CHASSIS WITH ITS OWN REAR CENTRE. the 300CB08/nrg300CB08/nrgILS300CB08 installation guide 149722-2 A9 covers the nrgILS beside the 300CB08 and the nrg300CB08, and captions its controller front, Fig. 3-2, and its plain rear, Fig. 3-7, for the nrgILS too. the nrgILS300CB08 datasheet (08.10.26 v.5) photographs the front and agrees with Fig. 3-2 in every feature, so the front, its legends and its parts are amphenol-ns/nrg300cb08-ctrl's. Its rear photograph shows a centre block Fig. 3-7 does not draw, and the guide's own nrgILS bottom view, Fig. 3-12, is 42.4 deeper than the 300CB08's; both are modelled from those, and Fig. 3-7 is not used for the centre block. the nrgILS controller configuration/user guide 155376 is a software guide and supplies only behaviour.

monitoring.note: The nrgILS measures feed and per-circuit voltage and current (voltage to +/-0.1 V from 20 to 60 V; current +/-5 % and +/-0.2 A) and reads an analog nrgTEMP probe and an I2C nrgILSTEMP temperature and humidity probe (the nrgILS300CB08 datasheet (08.10.26 v.5); the nrgILS controller configuration/user guide 155376, section 6.1). Each output passes through a solid-state switch the software can open, which a DIP switch per circuit overrides ON (the 300CB08/nrg300CB08/nrgILS300CB08 installation guide 149722-2 A9, step 21; the nrgILS controller configuration/user guide 155376, section 6.3). NO DOCUMENT STATES WHAT THE PANEL DRAWS, so `power-max-w` is not given (gap panel-draw).

network.note: THE DATASHEET LISTS ONE ETHERNET CONNECTION, 10/100/1000 WITH PoE AND IPv4/IPv6; the front carries two jacks, MGMT and LAN, in Fig. 3-2 and in both datasheet photographs. Which jack the datasheet means, what the other does on this firmware, and whether PoE powers the controller or is offered on the port, no document held says (gaps ethernet-ports, poe-role). Both are recorded as the same gigabit jack. Both jacks are turned 180: Fig. 3-2 draws their lamp windows at the top, and the datasheet close-up agrees. The address printed above MGMT is not drawn, as on amphenol-ns/nrg300cb08-ctrl.

ratings.note: The nrgILS datasheet gives the maximum input load as 325A @45 C per panel; the installation guide that covers the nrgILS prints the same row with its de-rating to 200 A at 70 C. That is what `operating-temp` carries.

rear.note: The plain rear of the 300CB08 (Fig. 3-6, at 3.2006 px/mm) with the nrgILS centre block where the passive panel has its alarm card. THE CENTRE BLOCK IS NOT FIG. 3-7: that figure, captioned for the nrgILS beside the nrgSMART panels, draws five-way nrgNET headers and two probe jacks, while the guide's own specifications give ILS panels a removable RJ45 nrgNET connector and the nrgILS datasheet photographs two stacked RJ45 jacks under an nrgNET legend. See amphenol-ns/nrg-ils-rear-block@1 for how little of it could be measured.

rear-cover.note: NOT DRAWN. A clear polycarbonate cover closes the whole rear over the input and output terminals (datasheet, Primary Features; guide Fig. 2-20). It is transparent and everything behind it is what the rear view shows.
